arabic: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
translationEn: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.

arabic: بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ
translationEn: Islam is built upon five: the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, giving zakat, the pilgrimage, and fasting Ramadan.

arabic: مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِي أَمْرِنَا هَذَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ رَدٌّ
translationEn: Whoever introduces into this matter of ours something that is not from it, it is to be rejected.

arabic: الْحَلَالُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَهُمَا أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَاتٌ
translationEn: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between them are matters that are doubtful.

arabic: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
translationEn: Religion is sincerity and goodwill.

arabic: ذَرْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
translationEn: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.

arabic: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
translationEn: Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is leaving what does not concern him.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
translationEn: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
translationEn: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

arabic: لَا تَغْضَبْ
translationEn: Do not become angry.

arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
translationEn: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good deed and it will erase it; and treat people with good character.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ
translationEn: Indeed Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty.

arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
translationEn: The strong one is not the one who out-wrestles people; the strong one is the one who controls himself when angry.

arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
translationEn: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not drive people away.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
translationEn: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if they are few.

arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
translationEn: Your smile in the face of your brother is charity.

arabic: كُلُّ مَعْرُوفٍ صَدَقَةٌ
translationEn: Every act of kindness is charity.

arabic: لَا تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلَا تَبَاغَضُوا، وَلَا تَدَابَرُوا، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا
translationEn: Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, do not turn away from one another; be servants of Allah, brothers.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
translationEn: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.

arabic: لَا يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ
translationEn: He who does not thank people does not thank Allah.

arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ، وَأَنَا خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِي
translationEn: The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.

arabic: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا، نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
translationEn: Whoever relieves a believer's distress in this world, Allah will relieve his distress on the Day of Resurrection.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ، وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
translationEn: Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.

arabic: مَنْ تَرَكَ شَيْئًا لِلَّهِ، عَوَّضَهُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا مِنْهُ
translationEn: Whoever gives up something for the sake of Allah, Allah will replace it with something better.

arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
translationEn: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

arabic: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ، فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ
translationEn: Whoever guides someone to goodness will have a reward like the one who does it.

arabic: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ، فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ
translationEn: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the falsest of speech.

arabic: الْإِيمَانُ بِضْعٌ وَسَبْعُونَ شُعْبَةً، وَالْحَيَاءُ شُعْبَةٌ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ
translationEn: Faith has over sixty branches, and modesty is a branch of faith.

arabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الْإِيمَانِ
translationEn: Purity is half of faith.

arabic: طَلَبُ الْعِلْمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ
translationEn: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.

arabic: مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمْ، لَا يُرْحَمْ
translationEn: Whoever is not merciful will not be shown mercy.

arabic: أَعْطُوا الْأَجِيرَ أَجْرَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجِفَّ عَرَقُهُ
translationEn: Give the worker his wages before his sweat dries.

arabic: إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translationEn: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.

arabic: كَلِمَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ صَدَقَةٌ
translationEn: A good word is charity.

arabic: مَنْ يَضْمَنْ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ، أَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ
translationEn: Whoever guarantees me what is between his jaws and what is between his legs, I guarantee him Paradise.

arabic: قِرَّ مَعَهَا، فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِهَا
translationEn: Stay close to her, for Paradise lies beneath her feet.

arabic: أَكْثِرُوا ذِكْرَ هَاذِمِ اللَّذَّاتِ: الْمَوْتِ
translationEn: Remember often the destroyer of pleasures: death.

arabic: اغْتَنِمْ خَمْسًا قَبْلَ خَمْسٍ: شَبَابَكَ قَبْلَ هَرَمِكَ، وَصِحَّتَكَ قَبْلَ سَقَمِكَ، وَغِنَاكَ قَبْلَ فَقْرِكَ، وَفَرَاغَكَ قَبْلَ شُغْلِكَ، وَحَيَاتَكَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِكَ
translationEn: Take advantage of five things before five others: your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before your busyness, and your life before your death.

arabic: إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لَا يَكُونُ فِي شَيْءٍ إِلَّا زَانَهُ
translationEn: Kindness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it.

arabic: إِنَّ عِظَمَ الْجَزَاءِ مَعَ عِظَمِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَحَبَّ قَوْمًا ابْتَلَاهُمْ
translationEn: Great reward comes with great trial. When Allah loves a people, He tests them.

arabic: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ
translationEn: How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all his affairs are good.

arabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
translationEn: True richness is not having many possessions; true richness is contentment of the soul.

arabic: أَفْضَلُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ
translationEn: The best prayer after the obligatory ones is the night prayer.

arabic: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
translationEn: Two words light on the tongue, heavy on the scale: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-'Azim.

arabic: لِكُلِّ دِينٍ خُلُقٌ، وَخُلُقُ الْإِسْلَامِ الْحَيَاءُ
translationEn: Every religion has a distinctive character, and the character of Islam is modesty.

arabic: مَنْ هَمَّ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا، كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ كَامِلَةً
translationEn: Whoever intends a good deed and does not do it, Allah records it with Him as a complete good deed.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلًا أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
translationEn: Indeed, Allah loves that when one of you does a task, he does it with excellence.

arabic: لَا تَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ بَيْنَكُمْ
translationEn: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Spread peace among yourselves.

arabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُهُ، مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
translationEn: The example of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not remember Him is like the living and the dead.

arabic: إِنْ قَامَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَفِي يَدِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَسِيلَةٌ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ أَنْ لَا تَقُومَ حَتَّى يَغْرِسَهَا، فَلْيَغْرِسْهَا
translationEn: If the Hour comes while one of you is holding a palm shoot, let him plant it if he can before it comes.

arabic: اتَّقِ دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُومِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ حِجَابٌ
translationEn: Beware of the supplication of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah.
